description: Text to image, or an edit / combination when `images` are given. Returns the image (inline when small) and its URL. The free tier runs studio-image-v1 without a key; other models need TANVO_API_KEY. Credits are charged per run and refunded if it fails.

aspect.description: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4 … as the model allows (default: the model's)

images.description: Photos as local file paths or public https URLs. Local files are uploaded for you.

prompt.description: What to make: subject, setting, light and style. For edits, say what to change and what to keep.

resolution.description: 1K, 2K or 4K where the model supports it (default: the model's)

save_to.description: Optional folder to download the results into (defaults to TANVO_OUTPUT_DIR when set)

wait.description: Wait for the image (usually under a minute)

name: generate_image
title: Generate or edit an image
